### Summary

I previously ran `uv python install --default`, which installed 3.14.7. I wanted to install a different version and make it the default interpreter, so I ran `uv python install --default 3.14.6`. It installed 3.14.6, but did not make the default interpreter. The symlinks in `~/.local/bin/` still point to 3.14.7.

### Platform

macOS 15 x86_64

### Version

uv 0.12.3 (Homebrew 2026-08-07 x86_64-apple-darwin)

### Python version

_No response_
title: `uv python install` ignores `--default` when older version is specified
